name: mirror_element
description: Mirror a cube or group (with its children) across an axis about a pivot — build one side of a symmetric model, then mirror it. Flips geometry and the off-axis rotation signs, and renames left<->right. Returns the created clones.

element.description: uuid or name of the cube/group to mirror (single form).

elements.description: Or a list of uuids/names to mirror.

pivot.description: Coordinate on that axis to mirror about (default 0 = centre line).
